source_refs.note: Book p. 203-204: 11.3 periodicity and period, Theorem 11.1 (sine, 2pi) and 11.2 (tangent, pi) with proofs, Note box, Example 1. Print slips: tan(0 - p) for tan(0 + p); Example 1(ii) line jumbled. Teaching notes and checks are ours.

blocks.text: Aaj ka sabaq aisi cheez ke baare mein hai jo aap roz dekhte hain: dohraana (repetition). Har 7 din baad wahi din aa jata hai, har 12 ghante baad ghari ki sui wahin aa jaati hai, har saal wahi mausam laut'ta hai. Trigonometric functions bhi aise hi hain: ek khaas faasle ke baad un ki values bilkul wahi ho jaati hain. Aaj hum yeh faasla (period) nikaalna seekhenge aur do theorems saabit karenge. Yeh sabaq aage graphs ke liye bunyaad hai: jab aap ko maloom ho ke graph kitne faasle baad dohraata hai, to sirf ek tukra bana kar baqi graph usi tukre ko aage peeche dohra kar ban jata hai.

Kitab kehti hai: chhe ke chhe trigonometric functions \(\theta\) mein \(2\pi\) ke har izafe ya kami par apni values dohraate hain; is liye \(\theta\) aur \(\theta \pm 2n\pi\) (jahan \(\theta \in \mathbb{R}\) aur \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)) par trigonometric functions ki values ek jaisi hoti hain. Trigonometric functions ke is bartao ko periodicity kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Unit circle par sochiye. Angle mein \(2\pi\) jama karna yani terminal side ko ek poora chakkar ghumana. Poore chakkar ke baad side wapas usi point \(P(x, y)\) par aa jaati hai. Wahi point, to wahi \(x\) aur wahi \(y\), aur is liye chhe ke chhe functions ki wahi values:
\[\sin(\theta + 2\pi) = \sin\theta, \quad \cos(\theta - 4\pi) = \cos\theta\]
\(-4\pi\) ka matlab ulti simt mein do poore chakkar; phir bhi wahi point.

Kisi trigonometric function ka period woh sab se chhota positive number hai jo angle ki asal circular measure (radian measure) mein jama karne se function ki wahi value de. Ek function periodic hai agar function ke domain ke tamaam \(\theta\) ke liye \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\) ho, aur \(p\) ki sab se chhoti positive value function ka period kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is definition mein do shartein chhupi hain, dono zaroori:
1. \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\) har \(\theta\) ke liye sach ho, sirf kisi ek angle ke liye nahin.
2. Aise tamaam positive numbers \(p\) mein se period sab se chhota wala hai. Sine ke liye \(2\pi\), \(4\pi\), \(6\pi\) sab values dohraate hain, lekin period sirf \(2\pi\) hai. Jaise hafta 14 din baad bhi dohraata hai, lekin hum kehte hain hafta 7 din ka hai.
Ab chaliye trigonometric functions ke periods dhoondte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Proof parhne se pehle us ka naqsha (plan) samajh lijiye, taa ke har line ka maqsad saaf rahe. Dono theorems mein teen qadam hain:
1. Maan lo \(p\) period hai, yani \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\) har \(\theta\) ke liye.
2. Ek aasan angle \(\theta = 0\) rakh kar \(p\) ke mumkin candidates ki list banao.
3. List mein se sab se chhote positive candidate se shuru kar ke aazmao; jo pehla candidate har \(\theta\) par chal jaye, wahi period hai.
Yeh tareeqa yaad kar lein; Note box kehta hai ke baqi chaar functions ke periods bhi isi tarah saabit hote hain, aur exam mein inhein saabit karne ka sawal aa sakta hai.
Theorem 11.1: Sine ek periodic function hai aur is ka period \(2\pi\) hai.

Proof: Maan lijiye \(p\) sine function ka period hai, yani
\[\sin(\theta + p) = \sin\theta \quad \text{for all } \theta \in \mathbb{R} \quad \text{(A)}\]
Ab \(\theta = 0\) rakhein:
\[\sin(0 + p) = \sin 0\]
\[\Rightarrow \sin p = 0\]
\[\Rightarrow p = 0, +\pi, +2\pi, +3\pi, \ldots\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(\theta = 0\) kyun rakha? Equation (A) har \(\theta\) ke liye sach honi chahiye, to \(\theta = 0\) ke liye bhi zaroor sach hogi. Is se \(p\) ke liye ummeedwaron (candidates) ki ek chhoti si list mil jaati hai: woh numbers jin ka sine zero hai, yani \(\pi\) ke multiples. Period inhi mein se koi hoga; ab sirf yeh dekhna hai ke sab se chhota kaun sa har \(\theta\) par kaam karta hai.
Misaal: jaise imtihan mein pehle saare ghalat options kaat dete hain aur bache hue options ko ek ek kar ke aazmaate hain.
\(p = 0\) foran nikal jata hai, kyun ke period positive hona chahiye. (\(0\) jama karne se to har cheez wahi rehti hai; is mein koi khabar nahin.)

(i) Agar \(p = \pi\), to (A) se
\[\sin(\theta + \pi) = \sin\theta \quad \text{(sach nahin)}\]
\[\because \sin(\pi + \theta) = -\sin\theta\]
Is liye \(\pi\), \(\sin\theta\) ka period nahin.
(ii) Agar \(p = 2\pi\), to (A) se
\[\sin(\theta + 2\pi) = \sin\theta, \quad \text{jo sach hai}\]
\[\because \sin(0 + 2\pi) = \sin 0\]
Kyun ke \(2\pi\) woh sab se chhota positive real number hai jis ke liye \(\sin(\theta + 2\pi) = \sin\theta\), is liye \(2\pi\), \(\sin\theta\) ka period hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(p = \pi\) fail kyun hua? \(\pi\) jama karna yani aadha chakkar: point \(P(x, y)\) bilkul saamne wale point \((-x, -y)\) par chala jata hai, aur sine ka sign ulat jata hai. Misaal: \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\) lekin \(\sin\frac{3\pi}{2} = -1\). Ek counter-example (ulti misaal) hi \(\pi\) ko rad karne ke liye kaafi hai.
\(p = 2\pi\) har \(\theta\) ke liye kyun chalta hai? \(2\pi\) poora chakkar hai jo har point ko wapas usi jagah le aata hai. Kitab ne \(\theta = 0\) wali soorat likhi hai; yahi wajah har \(\theta\) par lagti hai. Aur kyun ke candidates sirf \(\pi, 2\pi, 3\pi, \ldots\) the aur \(\pi\) fail ho gaya, is liye \(2\pi\) hi sab se chhota hai. Proof mukammal.
Theorem 11.2: Tangent ek periodic function hai aur is ka period \(\pi\) hai.

Proof: Maan lijiye \(p\) tangent function ka period hai, yani
\[\tan(\theta + p) = \tan\theta \quad \text{for all } \theta \in \mathbb{R} \quad \text{(B)}\]
Ab \(\theta = 0\) rakhein:
\(\tan(0 + p) = \tan 0\) \(\Rightarrow \tan p = 0\)
\[p = 0, \pi, 2\pi, 3\pi, \ldots\]
(i) Agar \(p = \pi\), to (B) se \(\tan(\theta + \pi) = \tan\theta\), jo sach hai.
Kyun ke \(\pi\) woh sab se chhota positive number hai jis ke liye \(\tan(\theta + \pi) = \tan\theta\),
is liye \(\pi\), \(\tan\theta\) ka period hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text:
\(\tan p = 0\) kab hota hai? Jab \(\sin p = 0\), yani \(p\) \(\pi\) ka multiple ho. Is liye candidates phir se \(\pi, 2\pi, 3\pi, \ldots\) hain, bilkul sine wali list. Farq sirf yeh hai ke sine ke liye pehla candidate \(\pi\) fail hua tha, aur tangent ke liye \(\pi\) pehli hi koshish mein kaamyaab ho gaya.
\(0\) aur \(\pi\) ke darmiyan koi aur candidate kyun nahin? Kyun ke us hisse mein \(\tan p\) kabhi zero nahin hota (pehle quadrant mein positive, doosre mein negative, aur \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par undefined). Is liye \(\pi\) se chhota koi positive period mumkin hi nahin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: (B) mein \(\theta = 0\) rakhne ke baad kitab \(\tan(0 - p) = \tan 0\) chhaapti hai. Sahi \(\tan(0 + p) = \tan 0\) hai, jis se \(\tan p = 0\) milta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(\tan(\theta + \pi) = \tan\theta\) sach kyun hai? Aadha chakkar sine aur cosine dono ke sign ulat deta hai, aur do minus aapas mein kat jaate hain:
\[\tan(\theta + \pi) = \dfrac{\sin(\theta + \pi)}{\cos(\theta + \pi)}\]
\[= \dfrac{-\sin\theta}{-\cos\theta} = \tan\theta\]
Is liye tangent sirf aadhe chakkar mein dohra jata hai, aur us ka period \(\pi\) sine ke period ka aadha hai. Tangent ke liye \(\pi\) pehla hi candidate tha aur woh chal gaya, is liye yahan sirf ek case (i) kaafi tha.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text:
Sine aur tangent ke periods nikaalne wala tareeqa apna kar hum saabit kar sakte hain ke
(i) \(2\pi\), \(\cos\theta\) ka period hai
(ii) \(2\pi\), \(\csc\theta\) ka period hai
(iii) \(2\pi\), \(\sec\theta\) ka period hai
(iv) \(\pi\), \(\cot\theta\) ka period hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(\cot\theta\) ka period \(\pi\) kyun hai, \(2\pi\) kyun nahin? Ishara: \(\cot\theta = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\).
Jawab: aadhe chakkar mein \(\cos\) aur \(\sin\) dono ka sign ulatta hai, do minus kat jaate hain, \(\cot(\theta + \pi) = \frac{-\cos\theta}{-\sin\theta} = \cot\theta\). Bilkul tangent wali kahani.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Example 1 se ek tez rule nikalta hai (hamara khulasa, jawab check karne ke liye): kisi number \(a \ne 0\) ke liye
\[\text{period of } \sin ax, \cos ax = \dfrac{2\pi}{|a|}\]
\[\text{period of } \tan ax, \cot ax = \dfrac{\pi}{|a|}\]
Constant jama karne se period nahin badalta. Exam mein phir bhi working Example 1 ki tarah poori dikhayein; sirf rule likhne se poore number nahin milte.
Ab kitab ki misaal mein yeh sab lagaate hain.

blocks.title: Example 1
steps:
Given: (i) \(\sin 2x\); (ii) \(3 + \tan\frac{x}{3}\).
To find: dono functions ka period, yani woh sab se chhota positive number jo \(x\) mein jama karne se wahi value wapas de.
Method: sab se pehle yeh dekhte hain ke humein kya maloom hai: sine ka period \(2\pi\) aur tangent ka period \(\pi\). Plan yeh hai ke angle (\(2x\) ya \(\frac{x}{3}\)) mein yeh period jama karein, phir bracket ko aisa likhein ke saaf nazar aaye ke khud \(x\) mein kitna izafa hua. Kyun ke sawal \(x\) ke period ka hai, angle ke period ka nahin.

Step 1: (i) Sine ka period lagayein
\[\sin(2x + 2\pi) = \sin 2x\]
Kyun: sine ka period \(2\pi\) hai, yani sine ke andar jo bhi angle ho (yahan \(2x\)), us mein \(2\pi\) jama karne se value wahi rehti hai. Angle ka naam \(2x\) ho ya \(\theta\), rule wahi hai.

Step 2: (i) 2 ko common nikaalein
\[\sin(2x + 2\pi) = \sin 2(x + \pi)\]
\[\Rightarrow \sin 2(x + \pi) = \sin 2x\]
Kyun: period ka sawal \(x\) ke badalne ka hai, \(2x\) ka nahin. \(2x + 2\pi = 2(x + \pi)\) likhne se saaf dikhta hai ke \(x\) ki jagah \(x + \pi\) rakhne se value dohraati hai. Yani \(x\) mein sirf \(\pi\) ka izafa kaafi hai.

Step 3: (i) Nateeja
Is liye \(\sin 2x\) ka period \(\pi\) hai.
Kyun: \(2\pi\) angle \(2x\) ka sab se chhota shift hai jo sine ko dohraata hai, is liye \(x\) ka sab se chhota shift \(\pi\) hai. Tasalli ke liye chhota shift \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) aazmaate hain: \(\sin 2(x + \frac{\pi}{2}) = \sin(2x + \pi) = -\sin 2x\). Sign ulat gaya, value wahi nahin. Is liye \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) period nahin.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin 2x\) mein angle do guna tez chalta hai, is liye chakkar aadhe waqt mein poora hota hai. Jaise do guna tez chalne wali ghari ki sui aadhe waqt mein chakkar mukammal kar leti hai.

Step 4: (ii) Sirf tangent wala hissa dekhein
\(3 + \tan\frac{x}{3}\) ka period nikaalne ke liye sirf \(\tan\frac{x}{3}\) ko dekhte hain.
Kyun: \(3\) har value mein jama hota hai; yeh poore graph ko 3 unit oopar utha deta hai, lekin is se yeh nahin badalta ke values kab dohraati hain. Jaise har mahine ki tankhwah mein 3000 bonus jor dein to tankhwah ka din wahi rehta hai.

Step 5: (ii) Tangent ka period lagayein
\[\tan\left(\frac{x}{3} + \pi\right) = \tan\frac{x}{3}\]
\[\Rightarrow \tan\frac{1}{3}(x + 3\pi) = \tan\frac{x}{3}\]
Kyun: tangent ka period \(\pi\) hai, is liye angle \(\frac{x}{3}\) mein \(\pi\) jama kiya. Phir \(\pi = \frac{3\pi}{3}\) likh kar \(\frac{1}{3}\) common nikaala: \(\frac{x}{3} + \frac{3\pi}{3} = \frac{1}{3}(x + 3\pi)\). Ab saaf hai ke \(x\) mein \(3\pi\) ka izafa hua.

Step 6: (ii) Nateeja
\(\tan\frac{x}{3}\) ki value tab dohraati hai jab \(x\) mein \(3\pi\) jama ho. Is liye \(3 + \tan\frac{x}{3}\) ka period \(3\pi\) hai. Constant number \(3\) jama karne se period par koi asar nahin parta.
Kyun: \(\pi\) angle \(\frac{x}{3}\) ka sab se chhota shift hai, is liye \(x\) ka sab se chhota shift \(3\pi\) hai. Yahan angle teen guna aahista chalta hai, is liye chakkar teen guna der mein poora hota hai.

Tasdeeq:
Ab numbers rakh kar dekhte hain ke jawab sach mein sahi hai.
(i) \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\) par \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\); \(x = \frac{\pi}{4} + \pi\) par \(\sin\frac{5\pi}{2} = 1\). Wahi value.
(ii) \(x = \pi\) par \(3 + \tan\frac{\pi}{3} = 3 + \sqrt{3}\); \(x = 4\pi\) par \(3 + \tan\frac{4\pi}{3} = 3 + \sqrt{3}\). Wahi value. Jawab durust hain.
blocks.answer: (i) \(\sin 2x\) ka period \(\pi\) hai. (ii) \(3 + \tan\frac{x}{3}\) ka period \(3\pi\) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Part (ii) ke hal mein "We know that the period of tangent is \(\pi\)" ke baad wali line kitab mein gadmad chhapi hai ("=" ke nishaan aur fractions ek doosre par). Sahi line: \(\tan\left(\frac{x}{3} + \pi\right) = \tan\frac{x}{3} \Rightarrow \tan\frac{1}{3}(x + 3\pi) = \tan\frac{x}{3}\), jaise Step 5 mein likha hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
\(\cos 3x\) ka period nikaalein (yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin).
\[\cos(3x + 2\pi) = \cos 3x\]
\[\Rightarrow \cos 3\left(x + \frac{2\pi}{3}\right) = \cos 3x\]
Yani \(x\) mein \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) jama karne se value dohraati hai; period \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\). Rule se check: \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\). Sahi!
Aur \(\sin\frac{x}{2}\)? \(\sin\left(\frac{x}{2} + 2\pi\right) = \sin\frac{1}{2}(x + 4\pi)\), period \(4\pi\).

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Periodicity: values dohraati hain; tamaam \(\theta\) ke liye \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\). Period aisa sab se chhota positive \(p\) hai.
2. Periods: \(\sin, \cos, \csc, \sec\): \(2\pi\); \(\tan, \cot\): \(\pi\).
3. Proof ka tareeqa: \(\theta = 0\) rakh kar candidates nikaalo, phir sab se chhote positive candidate ko har \(\theta\) ke liye aazmao.
4. \(\sin ax\) ka period \(\frac{2\pi}{|a|}\); \(\tan ax\) ka period \(\frac{\pi}{|a|}\); constant jama karne se period nahin badalta.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Tangent ka period \(2\pi\) likh dena. \(2\pi\) se bhi tangent dohraata hai, lekin \(\pi\) chhota hai, is liye period \(\pi\) hai.
2. \(\sin 2x\) ka period \(2\pi\) ya \(4\pi\) likh dena. Angle \(2x\) do guna tez chalta hai, is liye period aadha: \(\pi\). Bachne ka tareeqa: hamesha bracket mein se coefficient common nikaal kar dekhiye ke \(x\) mein kitna izafa hua.
3. Yeh samajhna ke \(3 + \tan\frac{x}{3}\) mein 3 period badal deta hai. Woh sirf values ko oopar khiskaata hai.
4. \(\sin(\theta + \pi) = \sin\theta\) likh dena. Sahi \(\sin(\theta + \pi) = -\sin\theta\) hai.
